name: 陳郁芬
objective:
全球化時代，無論是個人或是國家都無法自外於國際結構而不受其影響；因此，我們必須對國際現況有基本了解，對於國際結構發展趨勢應該有所掌握。課程規劃前五週著重建構國際大圖像與鋪墊國際關係理論基礎；六至十三週以議題型式為主，輔以當週或當月國際重要事件，帶入國際關係觀察角度；十四至十七週重點放在亞州區域情勢，從中美競爭的各面向、印太戰略到台灣議題皆包含在內。課程深入淺出，隨著各種議題擴展國際視野的同時客觀地建立國際關係系統性認知，培養同學獨立且多元思考，以及正確解讀資訊的能力。
An individual or a country may not keep alien to today's internatonal community. Owing to internationally interactive influence with respect to politic, economy, society and culture, the purpose of the course is to equip intellectual youths with internaitonalized sight and awareness to keep pace with the develolpment trend of times, and to expand the space for national, social and individual development on basic of reinforced technical research. The contents of the course include basic theory and the situation  of international relations, covering the structure and changes in the international community, the type of international behavior, and various forces dominating such behavior, the phenomenon, essence, cause and consequence of international affairs.
